summary: This note covers the music video for the song "Out of the Woods" by Taylor Swift, directed by Joseph Kahn. The video premiered on Dick Clark's New Year's Rockin' Eve with Ryan Seacrest on ABC on December 31, 2015, and was Swift and Kahn's fourth collaboration on the album 1989 after "Blank Space", "Bad Blood" and "Wildest Dreams". It was filmed on location in New Zealand, and a severe storm during filming forced an evacuation before shooting resumed a week later.
one_line: Overview of the music video for Taylor Swift's song "Out of the Woods", directed by Joseph Kahn and filmed in New Zealand.
key_facts: The music video for "Out of the Woods" was directed by Joseph Kahn.
The video premiered on Dick Clark's New Year's Rockin' Eve with Ryan Seacrest on ABC on December 31, 2015.
The video marked the fourth collaboration between Taylor Swift and Joseph Kahn on the album 1989.
The previous Swift and Kahn collaborations were "Blank Space", "Bad Blood" and "Wildest Dreams".
The video was filmed on location in New Zealand.
Filming took place in the mountains of Queenstown and on Bethells Beach.
During filming, a severe storm struck, causing trees to fall around the crew.
After evacuating due to the storm, filming resumed a week later.
